title: Weekend plans: Chloe and Sam prepare a camping trip

script.text: Sam, have you looked at the weather forecast for next weekend?
I have, and it's not great. Rain on Saturday, and then it clears up on Sunday afternoon.
Hmm. Should we postpone the camping trip?
I'd rather not. The booking at the campsite cost a fortune, and they don't give refunds. Besides, Max and Olga have already taken the days off.
Fair enough. In that case we need a proper tent. Does yours still leak?
Not any more. My uncle repaired it last summer, and I tested it in the garden during that storm in August. Not a drop came through.
Good. What about sleeping bags? Mine is a summer one, so I'll freeze.
Mine is the same. But my cousin has two spare winter ones. I'm going to pick them up on Thursday.
Lovely. And food? Last time we lived on sandwiches, and I never want to eat another one.
Agreed. I thought we could take a small gas stove and cook pasta. Max is bringing sausages for the first evening.
Max? He can't even boil an egg.
He says he's been practising, and he's bought a special pan. We'll see.
What about the route? The campsite is by the lake, isn't it? Is it far from the car park?
About three kilometres, but it's an easy path through the forest. The guidebook says it takes under an hour with backpacks.
Good. I've also been reading about the wildlife. Apparently there are wild boar in that forest.
Yes, but they're shy and usually keep away from people. The warden's advice is to keep all food in a closed container and not to leave rubbish around.
Sensible. Oh, and I'll bring my camera. There's supposed to be a view from the hill behind the campsite that's incredible at sunrise.
Then we'll have to get up early. I'm not good at that.
I'll wake you. I've already set the alarm on my phone for half past five.
Half past five! You're mad. Fine, but I'm not making breakfast before eight.
Deal. Right, I'll make a checklist and send it to everyone tonight.
Great. And don't forget the first-aid kit this time.

statements: Rain is forecast for the whole weekend.
The campsite will not give money back if the group cancels.
Sam's tent no longer lets water in.
Chloe already has a sleeping bag suitable for cold nights.
Max has taken a cooking course.
Chloe intends to take pictures of the landscape at first light.
discuss: Do you enjoy camping? What do you like or dislike about it?
What three things would you never forget to take on a trip into nature?
Would you stay at a campsite if the weather forecast was bad? Why or why not?
